nodes.title: Extensions of the additive group of a division ring
Homology of finitely generated metabelian groups

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and $N$ a normal subgroup of $G$ whose order is coprime to its index, and suppose $N$ is solvable. If $K_1$ and $K_2$ are complements of $N$ in $G$, then there is an element $g \in N$ with $g K_1 g^{-1} = K_2$.
